items.title: Litton under observation after groin injury
items.summary: South Africa piled up more than 400 runs on the second day, finishing at 494 for seven with a commanding 403-run lead. It remained unclear whether Litton would be fit enough to bat in the second innings.

items.summary: The Bangladesh players on the list are Hasan Mahmud, Parvez Hossain Emon, Ripon Mondol, Rishad Hossain, Saif Hassan, Mahedi Hasan, Shamim Hossain, Shoriful Islam, Tanzim Hasan Sakib, Tawhid Hridoy, Md Rubel and Taskin Ahmed.

items.title: Ackerman, Mulder tons grind down Bangladesh as SA batters make hay

items.title: Saliva ban to stay despite Gill's call to relax
